title: Young  NSW - Maintain the Network

cause.detailed_cause: nbn technicians relocated and spliced fibre cables. Temporary outage occurred during the cutover.

current_summary: Planned maintenance in Young, NSW has been completed. Services were affected during the scheduled window on 11 August 2026 between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEST. All works are now finished and normal connectivity has resumed.

updates.content: Planned works on the access network in Young, NSW are scheduled for 11 August 2026 between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEST. During this window, some services may go offline. A single interruption of up to 3 hours is expected from 12:00 AM. We will monitor the works and provide an update once services are restored. If you need to stay online, consider using mobile data where available. Thank you for your patience.

The scheduled maintenance works in Young, NSW have been completed. Services in the area returned to normal after the maintenance window on 11 August 2026 (12:00 AM–6:00 AM AEST). Thank you for your patience while these improvements were carried out.
